title: User Login
description: As a registered user, I want to log in with my email and password so I can access the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Login form is centered on the page
Email field validates correct email format
Password field is masked (type=password)
Both fields are required — empty submission shows error
Login button triggers form submission
On successful login, user is redirected to dashboard (TODO: API)
On failure, a clear error message is shown below the form
Form has a 'Forgot Password?' link

title: Navigation Bar
description: As a user, I want a persistent navigation bar so I can move between sections of the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation bar is visible at the top of every page
Brand logo is displayed on the left
Navigation links are visible: Home, Dashboard, Profile, Settings
The active link is visually highlighted
Navigation collapses to a hamburger menu on mobile (< 768px)
User avatar or initials shown on the right when logged in

title: Dashboard Overview
description: As a logged-in user, I want to see a dashboard with summary cards and key metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays at least 4 metric cards
Each card shows a title, a numeric value, and a trend indicator
Cards use a responsive grid layout (2 columns on tablet, 4 on desktop)
A recent activity list shows the last 5 actions
A chart or graph section shows data visualization (placeholder acceptable)

title: User Profile
description: As a user, I want to view and edit my profile information.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile page shows avatar, name, email, and bio
Edit button enters edit mode with editable fields
Save button updates the displayed data (TODO: API call)
Cancel button reverts changes without saving
Avatar shows initials placeholder if no image is set

title: Search Functionality
description: As a user, I want to search for items so I can quickly find what I need.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input is visible in the navigation bar or a dedicated search page
Typing in the search box filters results in real-time (client-side)
Empty search shows all results
No results shows an empty state message
Search results display item name, category, and a brief description
